LanguageData.MMD_AsylumEscapees.label: Asylum Escapees
LanguageData.MMD_AsylumEscapees.description:
You were confined in the high-security ward of a glitterworld psychiatric hospital. The doctors insisted that you were gravely ill, but all six of you knew the truth: they were the ones with a problem.

A riot sweeping through the hospital gave you your chance. You formed an improvised team, broke through the lockdown, seized a shuttle, and fled into deep space. The desperate journey has brought you to an unknown rimworld.

The shuttle is wrecked, and everything you stole was lost in the crash. You have nothing left—except six extraordinarily powerful and perfectly healthy minds.
LanguageData.MMD_AsylumEscapees.scenario.summary: Six escapees, each with a different extreme mental disorder. No supplies. Electricity is unlocked.
